knownLimitations: Only four dependency-outage scenarios have shared concrete fault-controller adapters; other accepted enum categories require trusted local adapters.
Not every requested per-operation PostgreSQL disconnect/timeout boundary has an independently cataloged live scenario.
HTTP provider contracts cover read response shapes, authorization and error expectations, not every mutation request/response.
DNS-specific and partition-specific adapters were not added or live-verified; real network timeout/reset/partial-response tests passed.
No per-scenario Prometheus/Tempo backend evidence was collected; existing instrumentation/tests were reused.
Cancellation cannot undo arbitrary uncooperative third-party effects; SIGKILL/host/daemon failure requires ownership-checked manual recovery.
JSON Schema conversion cannot encode every Zod refinement; runtime validator rejection tests remain necessary.
Live payment/refund restart checks reconstruct services over persisted state; real process-crash financial cases are evidenced separately by the existing regression.
